map.为什么签名对不上？: Why does the signature not match?
map.三个高频原因：一是参与签名的不是原始报文体而是解析后的对象（空格与键序已变），必: Three common causes. First, what gets signed is a parsed object rather than the raw request body (whitespace and key order have changed) — always sign the exact bytes you received. Second, the key contains stray whitespace or a newline. Third, the encoding differs (hex versus Base64).
